summary: Consensus Cloud Solutions filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting entry into an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with U.S. Bank as agent, comprising a $225.0 million senior secured revolver and a $300.0 million senior secured delayed-draw term loan facility maturing September 30, 2031, with DDTL availability through October 15, 2028. Pricing is base rate plus 0.75%-1.50% or SOFR plus 1.75%-2.50%, leverage-based. No amounts were drawn beyond transferring existing obligations. Proceeds are intended toward retirement of the 6.50% senior notes due 2028. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation.
